changelog:
Initial release of Government Contracts & Federal Awards skill:

- Search US federal contract awards by company name or keyword.
- See the latest government contract winners for sales-intent and lead qualification.
- Pay-per-call access using USDC via x402, with no API key or signup required.
- Fetch actionable procurement data for researching contractors, tracking competitors, or finding B2G opportunities.
- Simple HTTPS GET endpoints, returning JSON responses with live data from USAspending.
